elle (support): We have an escalation from ACME (ticket #1429). Customer reports that when their agent calls two tools in parallel (search + summarize), the results get mixed up — summaries sometimes include search hits from other queries. Happening ~5% of requests under load.

jay (eng): Can you paste a minimal request + response and any logs?

elle (support): Pasting sanitized request they used and snippet from our router logs. Notice the call_id collision in the request body (they reused a local id in their client):

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "input": "Find info on billing changes and summarize",
  "tool_calls": [
    {"name": "search", "call_id": "local-1", "args": {"q": "billing changes 2025"}},
    {"name": "summarize", "call_id": "local-1", "args": {"text": "<search results>"}}
  ]
}
```

elle (support): Router log around the request:

```
2026-11-03T15:42:01.123Z router INFO incoming request corr=cb7f3a call_id=local-1 tool=search dispatch->worker-a
2026-11-03T15:42:01.124Z router INFO incoming request corr=cb7f3a call_id=local-1 tool=summarize dispatch->worker-b
2026-11-03T15:42:01.293Z worker-a INFO tool_result call_id=local-1 result_id=r1 payload_len=512
2026-11-03T15:42:01.294Z worker-b INFO tool_result call_id=local-1 result_id=r2 payload_len=128
2026-11-03T15:42:01.295Z router ERROR assoc-tool-result corr=cb7f3a result_id=r2 associated_with=search expected=summarize
```

elle (support): Customer says sometimes the router associates r2 with search instead of summarize. They attached example responses where the summarize output contains search snippets.

tony (sre): :eyes: That "assoc-tool-result" error looks like our association map keyed by call_id + corr. If call_id is not globally unique per request, parallel calls can race when we update the map. Any chance we let call_id collide across tools?

jay (eng): I dug into dispatch code. We rely on the client-supplied call_id as the stable key when merging tool results. We should be normalizing to an internal uuid per tool invocation. Right now we do: assoc_map[corr][call_id] = pending. If two invocations arrive with same call_id concurrently we can overwrite.

jay (eng): Quick repro I ran locally with a small script that fires both tool calls with identical call_id and 1000 concurrent sessions: reproduces ~4% failure within 1k runs. Attaching snippet:```python
# pseudo
for i in range(1000):
  corr = randcorr()
  call_id = "local-1"
  send_tool(corr, call_id, "search")
  send_tool(corr, call_id, "summarize")
```

maria (cs): Customer is on Dedicated + paid support — they want ETA and mitigation.

jay (eng): Proposed mitigation: (1) emergency patch to namespace association keys as "corr:internal_tool_uuid" where internal_tool_uuid is generated at router dispatch time if client call_id is not globally unique; (2) short-term we can add a validation warning to fail requests that have duplicate call_id values across simultaneous tool_calls within one request (400 + helpful message); (3) long-term deprecate relying on client call_id for routing, accept but map to internal id.

elle (support): Can we do the validation check in the edge quickly? That would prevent the immediate customer problem until a patch ships.

tony (sre): I can push an nginx Lua/edge rule to inspect body and reject if duplicate call_id in tool_calls. Low risk, quick. Will need ops-bot approval for immediate change.

ops-bot: @ops request received: change-request edge-validate-duplicate-callid by tony. Runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/edge-validate-dup-callid

jay (eng): I'll start the router patch branch: router#fix/tool-assoc-uuid. Will add unit + concurrency tests. If we can get the edge validation out in the next hour it's fine to call that a hotfix.

maria (cs): Please prioritize. I'll let ACME know we're rolling out an immediate validation and working on a permanent fix. They asked for timeline 2-4 hours.

elle (support): Repro steps for support engineers to validate after edge rule: 1) run provided multi-call script with duplicate call_id -> expect 400 and message "duplicate tool call_id in single request". 2) run same script with unique ids -> should return stable, distinct results.

jay (eng): Notes for postmortem: add logging of client call_id vs internal uuid in router traces, and emit a metric for "assoc_overwrite" so we can alert if >0 per minute.

tony (sre): Rolling edge validation in 5m. Will report back with deploy id.

ops-bot: deploy status edge-validate-dup-callid: queued -> running (edge01, edge02) -> success (15:49:32 UTC)

elle (support): Thanks. Maria — can you confirm ACME received our mitigation message?

maria (cs): Message sent. They're testing now and said early signs look better. I'll update when they finish a full run.

jay (eng): I'll cut a PR for router patch and request expedited review.

elle (support): Closing loop here — will create follow-up postmortem if we see more incidents. For now marking as ongoing but mitigated.
